sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the nullification of the darkness of exile in the future redemption comes through a new light beyond relation to worlds, yet the world itself will not remain in exile because the light that relates to worlds contains within it an aspect of the transcendent light.

translations.translation: And it is necessary to understand,
for seemingly,
since from the perspective of the light that illuminates the worlds it is impossible for the darkness to be nullified
(and it is only pushed aside by the light),
and that which in the future redemption the darkness of exile will be nullified,
is because then there will be a revelation of a new light that is above relation to worlds,
then the world itself
(as it is from the perspective of its limitations,
including also the revelations that are related to the world)
would remain in exile, Heaven forbid.
And the point of the explanation of this,
is that from the reasons
for this, that creation was in such a manner that initially there is the light that is above relation to worlds and specifically from it is drawn the light that illuminates the worlds
(even though seemingly there should have been from the outset the drawing down of the light that relates to worlds),
is,
in order that the light that relates to worlds should have within it
(in concealment, at least)
something of the light that is above relation to worlds.
And based on this it is understood,
that even though the nullification of the darkness of exile will be through the revelation of the essential light that is above the light that illuminates the worlds,
nevertheless the redemption will be
(also)
within the limitations of the world,
for the revelation of the essential light that will be in the future redemption will shine in revelation also in the light that illuminates the worlds,
and through this—in the world.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the relevance of the topics in the maamar to the nullification of the darkness of exile, showing that the discussion of the inclusion of light in its source is because the nullification of darkness comes through the revelation of the included light, and that this applies even to light clothed in vessels.

translations.translation: And based on this, one can explain the relevance of the topics in the maamar to the nullification of the darkness of exile,
that this which the maamar elaborates on the matter of the inclusion of light in its source,
one can say,
is because the nullification of the darkness of exile is through the revelation of the included light
(as above, section 8).
And that which it explains that the nature of ratzo (running) and inclusion is also in the light that is in the category of enclothement and also in the light that is clothed in vessels,
is,
because in order that the nullification of the darkness of exile
(which is from the revelation of the included light)
should be within the category of the world,
it is through that the matter of the inclusion of light in its source is also in the light that is clothed in vessels.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the verse "He set a limit for the darkness," that the limit is placed at the beginning of darkness, meaning that the transcendent light, where darkness has no place, becomes relevant to the world, so that the future nullification of darkness will also be within the world as a dwelling for His essence.

translations.translation: And this is: "He set a limit for the darkness,"
for it can be said,
that the meaning of the word "limit" in this verse is
(also)
a limit
(and boundary)
at its beginning.
That is,
that the matter of darkness has a place of existence only in the light that illuminates the worlds,
and not in the essential light.
And it says, "He set a limit for the darkness"
(that this that there is a limit to darkness is because He set a limit for it,
but from its own perspective it has no limit),
for this, that darkness has no place of existence in the essential light that is not in the category of worlds,
is not relevant to the world.
And since from the perspective of the limitation of the world it has no limit at its beginning
(because it has a place of existence in all the levels that relate to worlds),
then also the limit at its end,
that in the future the darkness will be nullified,
would not, Heaven forbid, be within the category of the world.
Therefore, "He set a limit for the darkness,"
a limit at its beginning,
that the light that is not in the category of worlds,
where there is no place of existence for darkness,
will be relevant to the world.
And through this,
also the limit at its end,
the nullification of the darkness that will be in the future redemption,
will be in the world in its innerness.
For even though the nullification of the darkness that will be in the future is through that there will then be a revelation of a new light that is above relation to worlds,
nevertheless,
the world will be a vessel also for this light,
and through this the intention of "a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms" will be completed,
that the lower realm
(from the perspective of its limitations)
will be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
for Him, for His Awtsmoos.
